chapters.title: Plain recursion

frames.caption: Plain recursion — O(n log n + 2n) time, O(n) extra space. Input: max_envelopes(envelopes=[[1, 1], [2, 2], [2, 3]]). Step through to watch the code work on this input.
h = [e[1] for e in sorted(envelopes, key=lambda e: (e[0], -e[1]))] — e = [1, 1]
h = [e[1] for e in sorted(envelopes, key=lambda e: (e[0], -e[1]))] — e is now [2, 3]
h = [e[1] for e in sorted(envelopes, key=lambda e: (e[0], -e[1]))] — e[1] becomes 2
h = [e[1] for e in sorted(envelopes, key=lambda e: (e[0], -e[1]))] — h = [1, 3, 2]
